name: twisted-growers-checks
description: Repository-level gates for the Twisted Growers Enterprise OS. Deliberately separate from app/web/package.json so the front-end build is never altered by tooling — app/web/src is Agent B's lane.

scripts.check: npm run check:baseline && npm run check:theme && npm run check:parse && npm run check:numbers && npm run check:boundaries && npm run check:routing && npm run check:trend && npm run check:bridge && npm run check:rules && npm run check:wired && npm run check:lint
